name: Afgan
bio: Afgansyah Reza , B.Ec., known by the mononym Afgan (born May 27, 1989) is an Indonesian singer-songwriter and actor. [ 1 ] Afgan released his debut album titled Confession No.1 in January 2008, relying on the song titled "Terima Kasih Cinta". The album, which contains 13 songs, is strongly influenced by pop , soul , R&B , and jazz music styles. His debut as an lead actor in "Cinta 2 Hati" directed by Benni Setiawan and "Refrain" directed by Fajar Nugros.

credits.title: Mate's Rate
credits.overview: After getting fired, Uji, a graphic designer, teams up with her three closest friends to start a creative agency. Amid client demands, family expectations, and friendship dilemmas, she hopes this could be a new beginning. But deeper she goes, the more she realizes: every relationship has its price, friendship included.

credits.title: Wait For Me To Be Successful Later
credits.overview: Facing constant ridicule from his successful relatives every Eid, an unemployed man desperately races to secure a job before the 2026 family gathering to save his dignity and support his struggling family.

credits.title: Komang
credits.overview: Separated by distance and the arrival of a faith-aligned rival, a young dreamer from Buton and a Balinese wanderer must test whether fate is strong enough to reunite them after he leaves for Jakarta.
